post.title: Your unpaid family loan might be a gift to the IRS
post.ig:
The IRS may call your unpaid family loan a gift.
32% of people who lent a friend money didn't get it back last time (LendingTree, July 2025).
Forgive a loan and it's a gift: over $19,000 to one person in 2026 means a gift tax return.
A real loan gone totally worthless is a short-term capital loss, offsetting up to $3,000 of income a year.
Example: $5,000 bad debt at 22% saves $660, then $440 the next year.
Sources: IRS Topic 453, IRS Topic 409, IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32, LendingTree.
